proofs.text: Split `Lock it @env(macos) @env(windows)`; verify the operating system read is `windows` and the unknown tags are exactly `["@env(macos)"]`, so the second tag is refused rather than merged

rule_text: At most one `@env` per proof: the trailing one is the one read and the earlier one is listed as an unknown tag rather than merged with it

tests.body:
def test_a_second_env_tag_is_refused_not_merged(self):
        _clean, _tier, env, unknown = purlin_specs.split_proof_tags(
            'Lock it @env(macos) @env(windows)')
        assert env == 'windows', 'the trailing tag is the one that is read'
        assert unknown == ['@env(macos)'], unknown
